description: This Lua script is a comprehensive test suite for Lua 5.4, executing various tests, memory checks, and file operations, including custom memory and stack level reporting, and handling multiple test files.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Function to print and record messages during tests, unless suppressed by _nomsg.

methods.name: F
methods.description: Formats large memory sizes into human-readable strings with K and M suffixes.

methods.name: showmem
methods.description: Displays current memory usage, using T module if available.

methods.name: Cstacklevel
methods.description: Returns the number of C calls in the current stack, if T module is available.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Prints a header indicating the filename being tested.
